{SessionEntry} from '../types/session.js';\nimport {setLogger} from '../shared/logger.js';\n\n// Real upgrades over a real socket: what a list answers is the wire contract, and no double can observe it.\n\ninterface Frame {\n  type: string;\n  sessionId?: string;\n  resumed?: boolean;\n  entryCount?: number;\n  code?: string;\n  message?: string;\n  index?: number;\n  entry?: SessionEntry;\n  conversations?: Array<{sessionId: string; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string; entryCount: number}>;\n}\n\nconst lines: Array<{level: string; category: string; message: string; fields?: Record<string, unknown>}> = [];\nconst listen = (level: string) => (category: string, message: string, fields?: Record<string, unknown>) => {\n  lines.push({level, category, message, fields});\n};\n\nbeforeEach(() => {\n  lines.length = 0;\n  setLogger({debug: listen('debug'), info: listen('info'), warn: listen('warn'), error: listen('error')});\n});\n\nafterEach(async () => {\n  // Each server sees its sockets close before it stops, so no close lands after the logger below is restored.\n  await stopEngines();\n  setLogger();\n});\n\n// An ask sent once the handshake answers, read through a ping barrier: the pong can only follow every frame the answer wrote.\nconst askAfterConnect = async (url: string, outbound?: object): Promise<{connected: Frame; frames: Frame[]}> => {\n  const client = connectClient(url);\n  const frames: Frame[] = [];\n  let connected: Frame = {type: ''};\n  const ask = (frame: Frame): void => {\n    connected = frame;\n    if (outbound !== undefined) client.send(JSON.stringify(outbound));\n    client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'ping', timestamp: 1}));\n  };\n  await new Promise<void>(resolve => {\n    client.on('message', raw => {\n      const frame = JSON.parse(String(raw)) as Frame;\n      if (frame.type === 'connected') return ask(frame);\n      if (frame.type === 'pong') return resolve();\n      frames.push(frame);\n    });\n  });\n  return {connected, frames};\n};\n\nconst codesOf = (frames: Frame[]): Array<{type: string; code?: string}> => frames.map(({type, code}) => ({type, code}));\n\nconst upserts = (frames: Frame[]): Array<{index?: number; entry?: SessionEntry}> =>\n  frames.filter(frame => frame.type === 'entry_upsert').map(({index, entry}) => ({index, entry}));\n\n/** A store whose listFor counts its asks and answers none, so a test can tell whether the store was consulted. */\nconst countingStore = (): {store: SessionStore; asks: () => number} => {\n  let asks = 0;\n  return {\n    store: {\n      ...delegatingTo(new InMemorySessionStore()),\n      listFor: () => {\n        asks += 1;\n        return [];\n      },\n    },\n    asks: () => asks,\n  };\n};\n\ndescribe('a conversation list over the WebSocket protocol', () => {\n  it('answers the connected user with ISO summaries, forwarding limit and before while ignoring any client userId', async () => {\n    const seen: Array<{userId: string | number; options?: SessionListOptions}> = [];\n    const newestFirst: SessionSummary[] = [\n      {\n        sessionId: 's3',\n        createdAt: new Date('2026-01-03T00:00:00.000Z'),\n        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-03T00:03:00.000Z'),\n        entryCount: 9,\n      },\n      {\n        sessionId: 's2',\n        createdAt: new Date('2026-01-02T00:00:00.000Z'),\n        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-02T00:02:00.000Z'),\n        entryCount: 4,\n      },\n      {\n        sessionId: 's1',\n        createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),\n        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:01:00.000Z'),\n        entryCount: 2,\n      },\n    ];\n    const store: SessionStore = {\n      ...delegatingTo(new InMemorySessionStore()),\n      listFor: (userId, options) => {\n        seen.push({userId, options});\n        return newestFirst;\n      },\n    };\n\n    const {frames} = await askAfterConnect((await startEngineWith({sessionStore: store})).url, {\n      type: 'list_conversations',\n      limit: 10,\n      before: {updatedAt: '2026-01-03T00:03:00.000Z', sessionId: 's3'},\n      userId: 'u2',\n    });\n\n    expect({seen, frames}).toEqual({\n      seen: [{userId: 'u1', options: {limit: 10, before: {updatedAt: '2026-01-03T00:03:00.000Z', sessionId: 's3'}}}],\n      frames: [\n        {\n          type: 'conversation_list',\n          conversations: [\n            {\n              sessionId: 's3',\n              createdAt: '2026-01-03T00:00:00.000Z',\n              updatedAt: '2026-01-03T00:03:00.000Z',\n              entryCount: 9,\n            },\n            {\n              sessionId: 's2',\n              createdAt: '2026-01-02T00:00:00.000Z',\n              updatedAt: '2026-01-02T00:02:00.000Z',\n              entryCount: 4,\n            },\n            {\n              sessionId: 's1',\n              createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',\n              updatedAt: '2026-01-01T00:01:00.000Z',\n              entryCount: 2,\n            },\n          ],\n        },\n      ],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('with history off or absent, answers UNSUPPORTED and never asks the store', async () => {\n    const absent = countingStore();\n    const await askAfterConnect(\n      (await startEngineWith({sessionStore: off.store, history: {enabled: false}})).url,\n      {type: 'list_conversations'}\n    );\n\n    expect({\n      withoutFlag: };\n    const store: SessionStore = {\n      ...delegatingTo(new InMemorySessionStore()),\n      listFor: () => [{sessionId: 's1', createdAt: new Date(0), updatedAt: new Date(0), entryCount: 0}],\n    };\n    const {url} = await startEngineWith({sessionStore: store, history: {enabled: true}, orchestrator: midAnswer});\n\n    const client = connectClient(url);\n    const during: string[] = [];\n    const afterRelease: string[] = [];\n    let seen = during;\n    await new Promise<void>(resolve => {\n      client.on('message', raw => {\n        const frame = JSON.parse(String(raw)) as Frame;\n        seen.push(frame.type);\n        if (frame.type === 'connected') return client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'user_message', content: 'hello'}));\n        if (frame.type === 'entry_delta') {\n          client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'list_conversations', limit: 5}));\n          client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'ping', timestamp: 1}));\n          return;\n        }\n        if (frame.type === clients.splice(0)) client.terminate();\n  for (const hal of servers.splice(0)) {\n    const {wss} = hal;\n    await eventually(() => wss.clients.size === 0);\n    await hal.stop();\n  }\n  setLogger();\n});\n\nconst startEngine = async (store: SessionStore, userId: string | number = 'u1') => {\n  const hal = createServer({\n    app: (() => undefined) as unknown as Express,\n    wsAuth: async () => ({id: userId}),\n    sessionStore: store,\n    orchestrator: answeringOrchestrator,\n  });\n  await hal.start(0);\n  servers.push(hal);\n  const {port} = hal.server.address() as WebSocket(url, [HAL_WS_SUBPROTOCOL, 't']);\n  clients.push(client);\n  const frames: Frame[] = [];\n  let connected: Frame = {type: ''};\n  await new Promise<void>(resolve => {\n    client.on('message', raw => {\n      const frame = JSON.parse(String(raw)) as Frame;\n      if (frame.type === 'connected') {\n        connected = frame;\n        client.send(typeof outbound === 'string' ? outbound : JSON.stringify(outbound));\n        client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'ping', timestamp: 1}));\n        return;\n      }\n      if (frame.type === 'pong') {\n        resolve();\n        return;\n      }\n      frames.push(frame);\n    });\n  });\n  return {connected, frames};\n};\n\n// A store with only the five required members, so listFor can be omitted, recorded or made to InMemorySessionStore();\n    const seen: Array<{userId: string | number; options?: SessionListOptions}> = [];\n    const summaries: SessionSummary[] = [\n      {\n        sessionId: 's2',\n        createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),\n        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:02:00.000Z'),\n        entryCount: 4,\n      },\n    ];\n    const store: SessionStore = {\n      ...delegatingTo(inner),\n      listFor: (userId, options) => {\n        seen.push({userId, options});\n        return summaries;\n      },\n    };\n    const url = await startEngine(store, 'u1');\n    const before: SessionCursor = {updatedAt: '2026-01-01T00:05:00.000Z', sessionId: 's3'};\n\n    const {frames} = await askAfterConnect(url, {type: 'list_sessions', limit: 10, before, userId: 'u2'});\n\n    expect({seen, frames}).toEqual({\n      seen: [{userId: 'u1', options: {limit: 10, before}}],\n      frames: [\n        {\n          type: 'session_list',\n          sessions: [\n            {\n              sessionId: 's2',\n              createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',\n              updatedAt: '2026-01-01T00:02:00.000Z',\n              entryCount: 4,\n            },\n          ],\n        },\n      ],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('answers an empty session_list when the store has no listFor, and SERVER_ERROR with a ws error log when listFor throws', async () => {\n    const inner = new InMemorySessionStore();\n    const withoutList = await startEngine(delegatingTo(inner));\n    const failingList = await startEngine({\n      ...delegatingTo(inner),\n      listFor: () => Promise.reject(new Error('database offline')),\n    });\n\n    const unimplemented = await askAfterConnect(withoutList, {type: 'list_sessions'});\n    const failed = await askAfterConnect(failingList, {type: 'list_sessions'});\n\n    expect({\n      unimplemented: unimplemented.frames,\n      failed: failed.frames.map(frame => ({type: frame.type, code: frame.code})),\n      logged: error: 'database offline'}),\n        },\n      ],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('accepts a bare list_sessions frame and rejects a malformed limit or before with INVALID_MESSAGE without calling listFor', async () => {\n    const inner = new InMemorySessionStore();\n    let calls = 0;\n    const store: SessionStore = {\n      ...delegatingTo(inner),\n      listFor: () => {\n        calls += 1;\n        return [];\n      },\n    };\n    const url = await startEngine(store);\n    const badFrames = [\n      {type: 'list_sessions', limit: 'ten'},\n      {type: 'list_sessions', limit: -1},\n      {type: 'list_sessions', limit: 1.5},\n      {type: 'list_sessions', before: 'not-an-object'},\n      {type: 'list_sessions', before: {updatedAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z', sessionId: ''}},\n      {type: askAfterConnect(url, bad);\n      codes.push(frames[0]?.code);\n    }\n    const {frames: accepted} = await askAfterConnect(url, {type: 'list_sessions'});\n\n    expect({codes, accepted, });\n});\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"call_09e2018600f5472e82da4b46","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

fields});\n};\n\nbeforeEach(() => {\n  lines.length = 0;\n  setLogger({debug: listen('debug'), info: listen('info'), warn: listen('warn'), error: listen('error')});\n});\n\nafterEach(async () => {\n  // Each server sees its sockets close before it stops, so no close lands after the logger below is restored.\n  await stopEngines();\n  setLogger();\n});\n\n// An ask sent once the handshake answers, read through a ping barrier: the pong can only follow every frame the answer wrote.\nconst askAfterConnect = async (url: string, outbound?: object): Promise<{connected: Frame; frames: Frame[]}> => {\n  const client = connectClient(url);\n  const frames: Frame[] = [];\n  let connected: Frame = {type: ''};\n  const ask = (frame: Frame): void => {\n    connected = frame;\n    if (outbound !== undefined) client.send(JSON.stringify(outbound));\n    client.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'ping', timestamp: 1}));\n  };\n  await new Promise<void>(resolve => {\n    client.on('message', raw => {\n      const frame = JSON.parse(String(raw)) as Frame;\n      if (frame.type === 'connected') return ask(frame);\n      if (frame.type === 'pong') return resolve();\n      frames.push(frame);\n    });\n  });\n  return {connected, frames};\n};\n\nconst codesOf = (frames: Frame[]): Array<{type: string; code?: string}> => frames.map(({type, code}) => ({type, code}));\n\nconst upserts = (frames: Frame[]): answers none, so a test can tell whether the store was consulted. */\nconst countingStore = (): {store: SessionStore; asks: () => number} => {\n  let asks = 0;\n  return {\n    store: {\n      ...delegatingTo(new InMemorySessionStore()),\n      listFor: () => {\n        asks += 1;\n        return [];\n      },\n    },\n    asks: () => asks,\n  };\n};\n\ndescribe('a conversation list over the WebSocket protocol', () => {\n  it('answers the connected user with ISO summaries, forwarding limit and before while ignoring any client userId', async () => {\n    const seen: Array<{userId: string | number; options?: SessionListOptions}> = [];\n    const newestFirst: SessionSummary[] = [\n      {\n        sessionId: 's3',\n        createdAt: new Date('2026-01-03T00:00:00.000Z'),\n        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-03T00:03:00.000Z'),\n        entryCount: 9,\n      },\n      {\n        sessionId: 's2',\n        createdAt: new Date('2026-01-02T00:00:00.000Z'),\n        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-02T00:02:00.000Z'),\n        entryCount: 4,\n      },\n      {\n        sessionId: 's1',\n        createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),\n        updatedAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:01:00.000Z'),\n        entryCount: 2,\n      },\n    ];\n    const store: SessionStore = {\n      ...delegatingTo(new InMemorySessionStore()),\n      listFor: (userId, options) => {\n        seen.push({userId, options});\n        return newestFirst;\n      },\n    };\n\n    const {frames} = await askAfterConnect((await startEngineWith({sessionStore: store})).url, {\n      type: 'list_conversations',\n      limit: 10,\n      before: {updatedAt: '2026-01-03T00:03:00.000Z', sessionId: 's3'},\n      userId: 'u2',\n    });\n\n    expect({seen, frames}).toEqual({\n      seen: [{userId: 'u1', options: {limit: 10, before: {updatedAt: '2026-01-03T00:03:00.000Z', sessionId: 's3'}}}],\n      frames: [\n        {\n          type: 'conversation_list',\n          conversations: },\n            {\n              sessionId: 's2',\n              createdAt: '2026-01-02T00:00:00.000Z',\n              updatedAt: '2026-01-02T00:02:00.000Z',\n              entryCount: 4,\n            },\n            {\n              sessionId: 's1',\n              createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',\n              updatedAt: '2026-01-01T00:01:00.000Z',\n              entryCount: 2,\n            },\n          ],\n        },\n      ],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('with history off or absent, answers UNSUPPORTED and never asks the store', async () => {\n    const absent = countingStore();\n    const };\n    const {url} = await startEngineWith({sessionStore: store, history: {enabled: true}, orchestrator: midAnswer});\n\n    const client = connectClient(url);\n    const during: string[] = [];\n
